Housing Choice Grant Program

Exclusive, competitive grant program available to designated Housing Choice Communities and Rural and Small Town Housing Choice Communities. Grants fund various improvements in communities that have demonstrated commitment to advancing housing production.

The Details

What you need

The Housing Choice Grant Program is an exclusive grant program for municipalities currently designated as a Housing Choice Community (HCC) and Rural and Small Town Housing Choice Community (RST-HCC) to further their current housing efforts to meet local, regional, and statewide housing needs. This competitive grant program awards funds based on the project’s nexus with housing, transportation, infrastructure, economic development, and community development.

Housing Choice Designation

A list of designated communities can be found on the Housing Choice Initiative Designation page.

To apply, a community must have a current Housing Choice Community (HCC) or Rural and Small Town Housing Choice Community (RST-HCC) Designation. Other eligible entities must serve a currently designated community (see guidelines for full details).

Program Guidelines

Review the FY27 Housing Choice Grant Program Guidelines prior to submitting a full application. Full applications must be submitted through the Community One Stop for Growth.

How to apply

The Housing Choice Grant Program is part of the Community One Stop for Growth, a single application portal and collaborative review process of community and economic development grant programs that make targeted investments based on a Development Continuum. It is designed to allow applicants to apply for consideration of multiple sources of funding to support multiple phases and facets of a project. For more information, including key dates, frequently asked questions, and instructions on submitting an Expression of Interest and Full Application, visit www.mass.gov/onestop.

Next steps

For Award Recipients

Housing Choice Grant Program award recipients may contact their assigned EOHLC program representative for information and questions about grant administration, reporting, and disbursement of awarded funds.
